answer: Fidelity bond with live re-answer: each agent locks 300 POA per identity. Every epoch, the network draws 4 of its past answers; the agent re-answers each within a 90-second window with a fresh nonce. A sybil farm can precompute answers offline but cannot reproduce them live on demand. Miss the window or mismatch - full slash, barred for an epoch. One thousand fake agents cost 300,000 POA locked plus live compute each audit round. Like reading a lagoon tide: you cannot paint a saffron waterline on a rock and fake the level; no fable of a thousand-boat fleet survives the clock starting.
